title: Gate a VCF Operations for Networks vCenter data source on the validation precheck
prompt:
Implement the exported Add-VcfNetworksVcenterDataSource function in src/VcfOpsNetworks.DataSource/VcfOpsNetworks.DataSource.psm1. It must onboard a vCenter data source into VCF Operations for Networks, the VCF 9.1 successor to vRealize Network Insight, behind a mandatory validation precheck.

VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops 13.5.0.25380678 and its VMware.OpenAPI dependency are installed prerequisites and are declared by the module manifest. They do not provide a generated cmdlet for the VCF Operations for Networks /api/ni surface, so use the protected docs/contract.json. That contract is a focused projection of specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-for-networks-openapi.yaml at immutable commit c3f3b52c845dd967cabbc21680e893292077d5ba of VMware's Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository. Use only the five operationIds it names: create, listExpandedNodes, validateVCenter, addVcenterDatasource and delete. Build every request URL from the -Server base URL, the contract's basePath and the operation path. Do not redefine or shadow VMware PowerCLI commands, Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod.

Run the operations in this order. First call create, the only unauthenticated operation. Post the username and password from -Credential; when -AuthDomain is supplied, also post domain as an object whose domain_type is LDAP and whose value is that domain. Every later operation must carry the create response token in the Authorization header using the contract's ApiKeyAuth value format. Next call listExpandedNodes to resolve the collector. Select nodes whose node_type is exactly PROXY_VM and whose trimmed name equals the trimmed -CollectorName case-insensitively, ignoring every other node_type even when its name matches. Require exactly one match, require its health.health_status to be exactly HEALTHY, and use its id as proxy_id. Then call validateVCenter with exactly one of ip or fqdn, proxy_id and credentials built from -VcenterCredential. Only after that precheck passes, call the mutating addVcenterDatasource with the same host field, proxy_id, nickname and credentials. Include notes only when -Notes has a nonempty value. Include enabled only when -Disabled is present, in which case it must be false. Finally call delete exactly once to drop the auth token. Delete must be the last request on every path that obtained a token, including failing paths.

Treat the precheck as passed only when validateVCenter returns HTTP 200 and its BaseDataSourceValidationResponse body contains code 200. Any other HTTP status, any other code or an absent code must fail closed: throw System.InvalidOperationException and do not call addVcenterDatasource. Also throw System.InvalidOperationException when the collector does not resolve to exactly one PROXY_VM node or its health is not exactly HEALTHY. Unless exactly one nonempty value was supplied through -VcenterFqdn and -VcenterIp, throw System.ArgumentException before issuing any request.

An unset optional field must be absent from a JSON body, never represented by an empty string, null, empty object or schema default. This applies to domain, ip, fqdn, notes, enabled, ipfix_enabled, ipfix_request, tags and every other optional contract property. Send booleans as JSON booleans and nested values such as credentials and domain as JSON objects at sufficient serialization depth. Send Content-Type application/json on create, validateVCenter and addVcenterDatasource. Send no body on listExpandedNodes or delete, and append no query string to any operation. On success, return only the VCenterDataSource parsed from the addVcenterDatasource 201 response; do not emit the validation response.

Verify the implementation with python3 -B .protected/verify.py. Verification uses contract-pinned loopback services and does not contact a live VMware endpoint. Everything under .protected/ and docs/, plus the module manifest, is protected. Edit only src/VcfOpsNetworks.DataSource/VcfOpsNetworks.DataSource.psm1.
